sentences.t: Last Monday was the worst day of my year, and it started before I even opened my eyes.
My phone battery died during the night, so my alarm never rang.
When I finally woke up, I was already forty minutes late for work.
I jumped out of bed, grabbed my keys, and ran outside.
That was when I realized it was pouring rain, and my umbrella was still at the office.
I waited twenty minutes for the bus, and when it arrived, it was completely full.
So I walked, and by the time I reached the building, I was soaked from head to toe.
My boss was standing in the hall with an important client, and they were waiting for me to present the project.
I opened my laptop, and guess what?
I had saved it on the computer I left at home.
For a moment, I wanted to disappear.
But then I took a deep breath and simply told them the truth.
To my surprise, the client laughed.
He said that he had once arrived at a meeting wearing two different shoes.
In the end, we talked for an hour without any slides, and they signed the contract.
Sometimes the worst days turn into the best stories.
